findings.description: Direct inspection of the current regenerated pose previews confirms the static body poses now change correctly. Garment sleeves remain displaced from the raised and crossed arms, and the purple hem trim detaches far from the cloth in prone. The pose-render correction does not establish garment deformation or fit.

The overskirt is already irregularly collapsed in neutral, and sit/crouch expose underlayers and thighs as the front opens. Prone turns the skirt into a dense crumpled mass. This fails visual appearance and fit.

Current previews show gray patch-like torso areas and discontinuous shoulder/side surfaces. Images alone do not distinguish surface material defects from mesh gaps, so treat the defect as unresolved and blocking.

nextAction: Keep this prototype rejected. Correct the garment/avatar rest-pose and skinning basis so sleeves, rigid trims and pins follow the intended body or garment after cloth simulation; inspect neutral and arms-up first. Then reassess sit/crouch/prone and restore the authored pleat silhouette. Do not tune cloth shape before the deformation mapping is corrected. Dynamic cloth response, fit, collision safety, weights, complete UVs, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unverified.
